0:
set -eu
if [ -s /models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf ]; then
  echo "model already present, skipping download"
  exit 0
fi
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 -C - \
  -o /models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf.part \
  https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf
mv /models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf.part /models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf

# Skip chown on mounted volumes, only run on /app
echo "Starting Mydia (skipping chown on mounted volumes)..."
mkdir -p /config /data /media 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R 1000:1000 /app 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -n "$TZ" ] && [ -f "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" ]; then
  ln -sf "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" /etc/localtime
fi
exec /app/bin/mydia start

cd /app
pip install --no-cache-dir --target /tmp/packages -r requirements.txt
export PYTHONPATH="/tmp/packages:$PYTHONPATH"
python app.py

set -e
JQ_VERSION=jq-1.7.1
curl -sSfL --retry 3 \
  "https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/$${JQ_VERSION}/jq-linux-amd64" \
  -o /tmp/jq
chmod +x /tmp/jq
export PATH="/tmp:$${PATH}"
exec /scripts/run.sh
